hits.title: Sinha takes Instamart helm as Swiggy’s top-deck churn continues | Bengaluru News - The Times of India
hits.snippet: Bengaluru: Swiggy has appointed former Myntra chief Nandita Sinha as CEO of Instamart, replacing Amitesh Jha, even as the quick-commerce unit’s former chief operating officer, Ankit Jain, has joined Nykaa.The back-to-back appointments put the spotlight on leadership churn at Instamart. Jha, who took charge in Aug 2024, resigned on Tuesday to pursue opportunities outside Swiggy. Sinha will take over on Aug 3.Jain, meanwhile, has been appointed to lead Nykaa Now, the beauty retailer’s quick-delivery business. His departure, followed by Jha’s exit, means Instamart has seen changes at both the CEO and COO levels within a short span.In a LinkedIn post, Jha said he had joined Instamart when quick commerce was still seen as a “cash-burning machine”. He said his mandate was to improve the business’s economics and build a more efficient supply chain and dark-store network.“My specific mandate is complete,” Jha wrote, adding that he planned to take a short break before deciding on his next move.Sinha joins Instamart after stepping down from Flipkart-owned Myntra in April. ...
